summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a press release dated 18 September 2026 announcing that Non-Executive Director Lawrence Gozlan will present at the ASX SMIDcaps Conference on 23 September 2026 at 1:55 p.m. AEST, with an archived webcast available via the company's investor events page. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, regulatory clock, or structural mechanic is disclosed; the release restates ATH434 Phase 2/Phase 3 MSA development status. What to watch: pipeline and trial-timing updates only; no deal or arbitrage angle.
